reason: The canonical adapter assigned the heat capacity of every opaque surface to the zone mass node, but the solver's air-to-mass conductance used only floor area plus interzone-wall area. This left much of the represented mass weakly connected to the air node. The adapter now derives the coupling area from all canonical opaque surface faces. The correction follows the model topology and was not selected by fitting measured temperatures.

corrected_rc_mapping.mass_capacity: sum of canonical opaque-surface heat capacities assigned to the zone mass node
corrected_rc_mapping.mass_coupling_area: sum of canonical surface gross areas less opening areas for the zone
corrected_rc_mapping.legacy_compatibility: callers without canonical surface geometry retain the historical floor-plus-interzone estimator

scientific_label: Results under v1.3 are post-unsealing corrected diagnostics. The immutable v2 first holdout result remains published and rejected. This amendment cannot restore a blind-validation claim.
